# Diego de Sotto's Personal Blog

> my personal blog by Diego de Sotto — long-form notes on machine learning, embeddings, and LLMs, plus a Goodreads-backed reading list and a career history.

Every post is also available as clean Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL
(e.g. `https://ddesotto.com/posts/<slug>.md`), and the whole blog is inlined at
[https://ddesotto.com/llms-full.txt](https://ddesotto.com/llms-full.txt).

## Posts


## Pages

- [Books](https://ddesotto.com/books): reading list, grouped by year
- [Career](https://ddesotto.com/career): roles, education, and projects

## Optional

- [RSS feed](https://ddesotto.com/rss.xml): subscribe for new posts
- [Sitemap](https://ddesotto.com/sitemap-index.xml): every URL on the site
